environment.description: Celery worker deployed in namespace 'batch-workers' with Pod Security Standards enforcement at 'restricted' profile (Kubernetes 1.28+). The namespace label configuration applies pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted with pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: v1.28. Additionally, an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sDisallowHostFilesystem' is active cluster-wide with a Constraint targeting all namespaces matching label 'tier: compute'. The worker pod's securityContext specifies runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, with capabilities dropped (ALL). Volume mounts use only emptyDir and PVC (storageClass: gp3-encrypted) — no hostPath volumes are schedulable in this namespace due to the PSS restricted profile enforcement. The /app/uploads and /app/processed paths are backed by separate PersistentVolumeClaims with ReadWriteOnce access mode, meaning the unicode path traversal cannot escape the PVC-backed filesystem boundary to reach host-level sensitive files.
